# TEACHER MANAGEMENT USER FLOW

## 1. Login

* Admin Logs into the LMS
* Redirects to dashboard

## 2. Navigate to Teacher Management

* From the sidebar, admin clicks **"Teacher Management"**
* Redirects to **Teacher Management Overview Page**

## 3. Add new Teacher

* Clicks **"Add Teacher"** Button.
* Inputs required fields:
  * Full name
  * Email
  * Contact Number
  * Gender
  * Birthdate
  * Position (e.g., Subject Teacher, Adviser, SHS Faculty)
  * Assigned Department (JHS/SHS)
  * Optional: Upload profile photo
* System creates user account with a default or auto-generated password
* Sends welcome email with login credentials

## 4. Assign Subject to teachers

* From the teachers list, admin selects a teacher > clicks **"Assign Subjects"**.
* Chooses:
  * Academic year
  * Grade level(s)
  * Section(s)
  * Subject(s)

## 5. View and Edit teacher info

* From teacher list, admin can:
  * View profile
  * Edit teacher info (e.g., email, contact, department)

## 6. Monitor teacher activity

* Admin navigates to **"Activity Logs"** tab.
* Can view:
  * Last login time
  * Lessons uploaded
  * Assessments created
  * Grading activity
  * Messages sent
* Useful for performance reviews and audits.

## 7. Handle Inactive or Resigned Teachers

* Admin opens teacher profile > clicks "Deactivate" or "Archive".
* Options:
  * Temporary disable login
  * Permanently remove teaching assignments
  * Keep history for records/ reporting

## 8. Bulk import

* Admin clicks "Import teachers"
* Upload CSV or Excel template with multiple teachers.
* System processes and creates accounts in bulk.
* Error handling for duplicate emails or missing data.
